programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2511
programme.desc: Zannie, känd från bland annat Paradise Hotel, bor tillsammans med sin flickvän Amanda och deras nyfödda dotter i ett hus i Tomelilla. När Zannie fyllde 25 överraskade Amanda honom med en bil som kostade över 600 000 kronor...

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2512
programme.desc: 25-åriga Jerry från Stockholm är hyrbilsberoende och har det senaste året hyrt lyxbilar för över 85 000 kronor. Utöver det har han åkt taxi för nästan 35 000 kronor och en hel del pengar har gått till bensin.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2513
programme.desc: Arikson är den Stureplans-festande kocken som istället för att ta hand om sin son, sover bort hela dagarna. Han festar upp över 16 000 kronor i månaden.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2601
programme.desc: Norrköpingsparet Lisen, 24 år och Pontus, 28 år, kända från Biggest loser, sitter i en ordentligt knivig sits. Förutom Lisens skatteskulder på närmare 700 000 kronor ligger de efter med flera viktiga räkningar och de riskerar på sikt att bli vräkta.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2602

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 313

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 314
programme.desc: Fayme har fått diagnosen GAD, Generaliserat ångestsyndrom. Hon är lättad över att äntligen ha fått en diagnos och berättar om hur är det att leva med GAD.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 315

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 316

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 317

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 318

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 319

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 320
programme.desc: För Fayme är bästa stunden på dagen när pappa Moltas kommer hem från jobbet. Då springer alla barnen till pappa och Fayme kan äntligen pusta ut. Linn, Marcus och Tindra åker på semester till Marcus familj.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 321

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 322
programme.desc: Julia försöker få vardagen att gå ihop med tre olika jobb och att vara ensamstående mamma varannan vecka. Colin, som är väldigt klädintresserad ska äntligen få shoppa med Fayme.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Det är ett stressfyllt arbetspass för Katarina i Ludvika när hon måste hjälpa en person med en bil som vägrar starta, en EPA-traktor som tappat ett hjul och en buss som fastnat i en isig backe.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Telefonen går het i Åre efter årets värsta snöstorm, och Kent och Robin rycker ut för att hjälpa en man som åkt av vägen och en lastbil som fastnat i vad som lokalt är känt som ”mardrömsbacken”.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: En stor husbil har kört ner i diket utanför Sälen, och Hogan och Dennis rycker ut. I Ludvika lämnar Katarina över nycklarna till bärgningsbilen åt maken Tim, som snabbt får ångra det.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: I Åre försöker Robin rädda julen genom att hjälpa en postbil full med julklappar. Efter ett stort oväder i Sälen sitter både personbilar och tjänstefordon fast i snön och Hogan måste hjälpa till.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Katarina får jobba hårt när en personbil kolliderat med en älg. I Åre har ett hjul lossnat från en bil och Kent måste arbeta snabbt för att få bort den – men det visar sig vara lättare sagt än gjort.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: En bil har brunnit i ett industriområde i Ludvika, och Katarina måste snabbt rycka ut för att hjälpa. Martin måste flytta en saxlift som vägrar starta - hans sista bärgning innan han lämnar Gällivare.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Idag är vi i Cumbria med Hettie Jago, David Harper och deras Mercedes 280 SL från 1980-talet. De tittar på en match i Workington och upptäcker en traditionell fotbollsmatch som kallas Uppies and Downies.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Hettie Jago och David Harpers fjärde resa handlar om sjöarna, och de hoppas att deras Mercedes SL 280 cabriolet från 1980-talet kommer att klara de utmanande vägarna i distriktet. Hettie lär sig om en viktoriansk musikalisk pionjär.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Submarine
programme.desc: To locate a hoard of stolen money, the IMF takes the one man who knows its hiding place (guest star Stephen McNally) on a bizarre submarine voyage on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Brothers
programme.desc: The IMF turns itself into a surgical team to operate on a tyrannical ruler who has imprisoned the rightful king, his twin brother, on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 1)
programme.desc: Guest stars Noel Harrison and Diane Baker are drawn into a daring IMF charade that uses a trained falcon to help in a crown jewel theft in the first of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 2)
programme.desc: Barney is blinded in an accident, a bride-to-be is buried alive and Paris poses as a man he is unaware is marked for death in the second of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 3)
programme.desc: A trained falcon is summoned in a last-ditch rescue attempt when Jim Phelps finds his IMF endangered by a traitor's assassination plot in the last of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: MacGyver: Renegade
programme.desc: MacGyver is shocked when he learns that the thief who stole a vial of deadly bacteria from the Phoenix Foundation is an old friend who once saved his life.

programme.title: MacGyver: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A newly released convict bent on revenge hunts down MacGyver in the woods, using Pete Thornton and Jack Dalton as bait.

programme.title: MacGyver: Cease Fire
programme.desc: When MacGyver Is wounded during an assassination attempt and subsequently framed as the sniper he must rely on the help of an insecure schoolgirl to save his life and foil the true assassin's plan.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Black Corsage
programme.desc: MacGyver joins forces with a bounty hunter in the search for a woman who is the target of jewel thieves.

programme.title: MacGyver: Legend Of The Holy Rose-Part I
programme.desc: MacGyver teams up with a female archaeologist, Zoe Ryan, in the search for an ancient artifact known as 'The Holy Rose.'

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Pernille och Nicklas från Odense lever så litet att om de behöver lite privatliv har de bara toaletten att gå till. Nicklas drömmer om att ha ett kök med två ugnar så att han kan laga mer mat.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Wendy och Jesper från Kalundborg bor redan bra, i en lägenhet som har en otrolig utsikt. Men en kommande familjeökning innebär att de måste hitta något större.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Jonas och Louise blir chockade när de ser vilka hus de har råd med. Mads Mikkelsen och Tobias Edlev Nielsen arbetar övertid för att försöka uppfylla parets önskemål.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Mads och Mia vill flytta lite utanför staden - men inte helt ute på landet. Med Tobias och Mads hjälp, köper de ett hem som har exakt allt de inte gillar.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 401
programme.desc: I det första avsnittet möter vi Tine och Lars, som har svindlande åtta miljoner för att köpa ett hus och renovera. Men budgeten har inte hjälpt dem hittills - kan experterna vara till hjälp?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: House Party Disaster
programme.desc: Gänget återvänder med Charlottes kärleksförklaring till Gaz ringande i öronen - och Vicky har en sista konfrontation med Ricci. De har en USA-fest, men allt är inte väl då Charlotte bryter ihop - vilket slutar i Geordiehusets största gräl nånsin.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Apres-Ski
programme.desc: Gänget kyler ner sig efter det största bråket hittills, Charlotte ligger illa till hos chefen Anna, och stämningen mellan killarna och tjejerna är kyligare än på länge.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Best Of Geordie Tours
programme.desc: Vi ser tillbaka på den senaste och bästa säsongen med er dysfunktionella Geordie-familj och de berättar om all sprit och allt skitsnack. Vi ser det bästa ur säsongen och några nya klipp som ni aldrig sett förut!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Family Means Family
programme.desc: Stämningen är hög när Jay kommer på besök för ett par dagars festande. Charlotte försöker reda ut sina känslor för Gaz, Vicky dejtar och James och Holly bråkar - medan Gaz tar raggningstävlingen till nya höjder.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: House Divides
programme.desc: James och Gaz blir osams om raggandet och efter ett stormigt gräl tvingas James att lämna huset. Gaz och Scott tar en paus och tjejerna blir ensamma i huset. Charlotte har problem, Vicky hånglar och Holly hamnar i säng med Scotty T.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Vicky Meets Dan
programme.desc: Australiens snyggaste kille får tjejerna att dåna och Scotty och Gaz bråkar om raggningstävlingen så att väggarna får sig en törn. Gaz hamnar i bushen, Charlotte får en uppenbarelse, Vicky dånar och Scotty njuter av sitt straff lite väl mycket.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Den framgångsrike journalisten David har alltid försökt ge sin älskade son allt han behöver. Men vare sig David eller Nics mamma Vicki kan hindra sonen från att börja experimentera med crystal meth.

programme.title: Siesta Key: You Are In A Huge Pond Now
programme.desc: Juliette fortsätter stänga ute Chloe och Amanda i takt med att JMP utvecklas. Sam är splittrad mellan Meghans ultimatum och Jordanas 'BBL'. Brandon får chansen att visa upp sig inför en musiklegendar.

programme.title: Teen Mom 2
programme.desc: När Barb vägrar låta Jace komma över letar Jenelle rätt på henne. Briana ger Luis ett ultimatum. Kailyn och Javi tvingas träffas på Lincolns fotbollsträning. Chelsea och Cole har bebisfeber. Leah försöker hitta svar åt Ali.

programme.title: About Us
programme.desc: Ett par vill väcka liv i kärleken och åker tillbaka till platsen där de tillbringade sin smekmånad åtta år tidigare. De kämpar tillsammans för att nå varandra igen. Allt kulminerar i en hjärtskärande final när dolda sanningar kommer upp i ljuset.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.desc: Elvis är en karatekunnig motorcykelknutte som anlitas som karnevalarbetare. Först är han bara muskler och en avledning för de vackra karnevalflickorna. Men snart plockar han upp gitarren och får stället att släppa loss.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.

programme.title: Exhibit A: The Case of the Shoe
programme.desc: It happened on a native reserve in Southern Ontario. Two masked men broke into a house in the middle of the night. Living there were a husband and wife who owned a profitable gas station/restaurant. The masked men open fire, grab the money and flee.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 202 - Military / Internet ID Theft
programme.desc: In this story, veterans of Iraq and Afghanistan tell how their identities were stolen, destroying their families while they were away serving their country.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Hidden Secrets of Area 51 / The Haunting Shadows of the St. Augustine Lighthouse
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss America's most top-secret military base and explore the St. Augustine Lighthouse.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Sisters Donna and Jeannie are convicted after planning to kill Donna's husband with a hammer. Next, Evelyn pleads guilty to torturing and drowning a woman due to jealousy.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: American Siege

programme.desc: Nathan konfronterar Nathaniel, James sitter fast i en skotsk macka, och en chockerande återkomst hotar Chloes och Louis spirande romans.

programme.desc: Anna berättar för gänget att de ska till Belfast. Geordisarna njuter av allt vad staden har att erbjuda. Tahlia raggar till och med upp en servitör! Men se går allt åt skogen när Chloes och Sams förhållande når botten och de tar paus.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Tobi & Riley

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Double Dating

programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A brutal double murder shocks Northern California's peace-loving and laid back Marin County. With residents reeling, police chase an elusive killer through three counties and multiple crime scenes.

programme.title: The Accused: Episode 2

programme.title: Under Arrest: Bad Hair Day

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: År 1942 blir det mest betydelsefulla året i "Den slutgiltiga lösningen", då nazisterna börjar genomsöka Västeuropa och till och med tar judar från så avlägsna platser som de brittiska Kanalöarna.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: År 1943 härjar korruptionen på Auschwitz-Birkenau. Lägre får även en ny inkomstkälla – kläder och värdesaker som tas från judar som kommer för att gasa.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Stefan Idstam bygger vidare på sitt närspelssystem med slag från ruff och längre bunkerslag. Med enkla justeringar fungerar systemet på olika underlag och passar golfare på alla nivåer.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Stefan Idstam delar sin mest genomarbetade puttrutin, utvecklad under många år som proffs. På en liten yta visar han ett utmanande träningspass för erfarna golfare som vill vässa hela sin puttning.

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Råtta på Rymmen

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Grisly Murders of Jack the Ripper

programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Lock
programme.desc: A cold snap triggers massive challenges. Devan runs into gear problems while he ferries a mothballed DC-3 across the country. And Justin has to make a snap decision with his newborn son aboard his plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Den 26 januari 2001 knivhöggs Benjamin Hermansen till döds på grund av sin hudfärg. Mordet fick hela landet att delta i antirasistiska demonstrationer och protester.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: I början av 90-talet skakas Norge av flera mordbränder. 1993 hittades Øystein Aarseth död i ett trapphus i Oslo. Polisen riktar in sig på personer inom black metal-kulturen. En av de är Varg Vikernes.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Anne Elisabeth Hagen försvinner spårlöst från sitt hem hösten 2018. Hennes man, miljardären Tom Hagen, hittar ett brev i huset med krav på en lösensumma.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: En söndagsmorgon 2004 är den 22-åriga sjuksköterskestudenten Anne Slåtten på väg till jobbet, men hon kommer aldrig fram. 24 timmar senare hittas hon död i en buske. Vem dödade den omtänksamma flickan?

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1303
programme.desc: Det som startar med att en orolig man kontaktar SOS alarm om att hans vän i Visby inte går att nå eskalerar snabbt till ett av de märkligaste mordfall som hamnat på Gotlandspolisens bord.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1302
programme.desc: I mars 2017 får polisen i Örebro ett samtal från en kvinna som säger sig ha dödat sin rumskompis när han försökte våldta henne. När polisen kommer till brottsplatsen känner de att något inte stämmer.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Klovn: Falskt Skit Alarm

programme.title: Klovn: Det Muslimska Pianot
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska köpa ett begagnat piano. När Frank får reda på att säljaren är muslim tar han över förhandlingarna. Sådana saker kräver en man.

programme.title: Klovn: Baked Alaska

programme.title: Klovn: #metoo
programme.desc: Frank är ute efter hämnd efter det att Mia blivit förödmjukad av Per Pallesen i sin tesalong. Lene får besök av en god gammal norsk vän som driver Casper till vansinne med vilda machohistorier från Norge. Alltid mer vilda än något Casper har upplevt.

programme.title: Klovn: Gottegrisen
programme.desc: Man är missnöjd i området med den obehagliga, men duktiga slaktaren Lund. Så när Frank får en ”tjänst till godo” i den kriminella världen beslutar han sig för att lära slaktare Lund en läxa.

programme.title: Klovn: Tipo Napoli
programme.desc: Frank får den sorgliga nyheten att en god vän är död. Det handlar om en förfärlig frysboxolycka. När Frank får reda på att frysboxen senare är till salu blir han otroligt arg och beslutar sig för att själv rätta till saken.

programme.title: Klovn: Känner Du Till Typen?

programme.title: Klovn: Dubbeldipp
programme.desc: Casper letar efter en så kallad ”god vilja-present” till Lene, vilket alltid är ett högriskprojekt. Och Frank hamnar i en bitter grannstrid med två nyinflyttade kvinnor på gatan. Vem är mest kränkt? Den som kissar eller den som tittar på den som kissar?

programme.title: Klovn: Vila I Frid Mia
programme.desc: Frank har fått en liten depression. Casper har många bra idéer om hur Frank kan bli på bättre humör, och snart är Frank inblandad i både muggmålning och en Silas Holst-musikal. Men räcker det för att pigga upp en medelålders man?

programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee

programme.title: Den fantastiske räven

programme.title: Boomerang: Housekeeping
programme.desc: Bryson och Ari hjälper David få huset i ordning efter att han haft sex med Elaine. Ari och Bryson reder ut sitt groll, men David inser att han behöver komma bort från sina vänner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.desc: Det är dags för det årliga Borgmästarloppet, och borgmästare Överdängare har en hel del lömska planer. // När Ryder hittar en gammal skattkarta dröjer det inte länge förrän borgmästare Överdängare stjäl den!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna och Köldknäppen / Valparna Räddar en Basketmatch
programme.desc: En snöstorm drar in över Äventyrsbukten och förvandlar hela staden till en glashal isbana. // Borgmästare Rospigg utmanar Borgmästare Överdängares basketlag på en match. Det finns bara ett problem - Borgmästare Rospigg har inget basketlag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar ett Bröllop / Valparna Räddar Ace
programme.desc: Bonden Al och Bonden Yumi ska gifta sig, och valparna har fullt upp med att förbereda inför bröllopet. // Skyes favoritstuntpilot, Ace Sörensen, besöker Äventyrsbukten med sin nya fantastiska luftshow, men på vägen dit får planet problem med motorn!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpar på äventyr med Dinosaurier
programme.desc: Valparna besöker en arkeologisk utgrävning där de hittar tre dinosaurieägg. Plötsligt kläcks äggen, och tre flygödlor flyger ut! Nu är det upp till Paw Patrol att försöka fånga de förrymda dinosaurierna!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nya Valpen
programme.desc: Paw Patrol rycker ut med sin nya Paw Patroller för att rädda Jake som är strandsatt ute på isen. Valparna får oväntad hjälp från den modiga lilla Everest!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar ett äventyr / Valparna Räddar en överraskning
programme.desc: Marshall och resten av valparna lär Alex allt om eldsäkerhet // Det verkade först som en helt vanlig dag för valparna, men det dröjer inte länge förrän de får en stor överraskning! Det är nämligen 'Uppskatta Paw Patrol'-dagen!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Valinda / Valparna Räddar ett Stort ben
programme.desc: Valparna planerar en stor fest för Valle Valross. Men när han inte dyker upp, så upptäcker de att han träffat en ny vän vid namn Valinda! // Vid en utgrävning hittar kapten Piggvar plötsligt ett stort dinosaurieben!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar en Snuva / Valparna och Spökstugan
programme.desc: Medan Rubble och Ryder letar efter Als bortsprungna grisar, stannar Marshall hemma för att ta hand om de andra förkylda valparna. // Först försvinner Rubbles lunch, och sedan är plötsligt Jakes lunchlåda borta! Kan det vara ett spöke?

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Tjejer. Del 2
programme.desc: Henrys planer inför den stora skolfesten blir lite komplicerade när han även måste gå på festen som Kid Danger. När det sedan börjar köra ihop sig rejält på festen tvingas han ta ett drastiskt beslut.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry och Hackspettarna
programme.desc: När Pipers basketbollstränare slutar övertalar hon Henry att ta över tjänsten. Samtidigt som han försöker få laget i vinnarform tvingas han kämpa mot styrelsen för Swellviews Ungdoms-Rörelse, som är allt annat än förtjusta i hans metoder.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kapten Man på Semester
programme.desc: När Kapten Man blir inbjuden till sin kusins bröllop, lämnar han Swellview i Henry och Charlottes händer. Men det dyker snart upp problem när de tvingas ta hand om stadens problem helt själva.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsskojaren
programme.desc: När Kid Danger och Kapten Man möter Tidsskojaren, råkar Henry falla in i Tidsskojarens tidsmaskin, och tvingas återuppleva hela dagen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Saken är Biff
programme.desc: När han blir inbjuden till stadens mest exklusiva restaurang, bestämmer sig Henry för att ta med sig sin chef Ray dit. Men det hela blir betydligt mer komplicerat än vad Henry kunde ha anat.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hjälten Jasper
programme.desc: Efter att Jasper blir stadens nya hjälte blir Henry avundsjuk över att ingen någonsin tackar honom. Staden hyllar ju bara Kid Danger, och inte Henry.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jul i Finkan
programme.desc: När Kapten Man blir arresterad för att ha serverat mat utan ett hårnät tvingas han spendera julen i ett fängelse. Men Henry och Charlotte gör sitt bästa för att göra Kapten Mans jul så bra som möjligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Osårbare Henry: del 1
programme.desc: När Kid Danger skadas på ett uppdrag bestämmer sig Henry för att använda förstärkifieraren för att bli lika osårbar som Kapten Man. Men det går inte riktigt som han har tänkt sig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Osårbare Henry: Del 2
programme.desc: Henry får en minst sagt oväntad biverkan av förstärkifieringen, och nu måste han försöka dölja den för sin familj medan resten av gänget försöker hitta ett botemedel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Video på Villovägar
programme.desc: När Henry råkar skicka en video där han och Ray förvandlas till Kid Danger och Kapten Man till sin syster, måste han göra allt han kan för att få tillbaka den innan hon ser den.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Omvänt Universum
programme.desc: Henry och Charlotte hamnar i ett omvänt universum där Ray och Schwoz är onda och vill förgöra Piper. Samtidigt som de försöker stoppa onda Ray och Schwoz måste de försöka hitta ett sätt att ta sig tillbaka hem!

programme.title: Svenska fall

programme.title: Svenska fall

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat

programme.title: Den fantastiske räven

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie

programme.title: Teaaching Mrs. Tingle

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Uber Love

programme.title: Boomerang: Us Too

programme.title: Boomerang: Trust

programme.title: Boomerang: There U Go

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests

programme.title: Games People Play: A Wing and A Prayer

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe är en Klon Nu
programme.desc: Efter att Phoebe tagit på sig alldeles för många aktiviteter, hjälper Max till genom att skapa en klon så att hon kan vara på två ställen samtidigt. När klonen börjar ställa till det för den riktiga Phoebe måste Max hjälpa till att rädda henes rykte.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Peter Tobin
programme.desc: Peter Tobin is one of the most notorious serial killers in the UK. From 1991–2006 he raped and murdered three young girls; Dinah McNicol, Vicky Hamilton and Angelika Kluk. Yet even prior to these horrific murders he had a history of violence.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Saint
programme.desc: A frat boy lures a girl to his house with the promise of a party, but once there it turns out he has ulterior motives. When the girl says no, he violently attacks her. A string of violence is finally uncovered, revealing a sinister trail of violence.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Booze Recovery Team
programme.desc: Police investigate a theft of alcohol, a man with a knife takes hostages and sports car leads police on a high-speed chase.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Teenagers stumble across a horrifying car fire on the side of a desolate stretch of roadway. When the police arrive, they pull severely burned human remains from the driver’s seat.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Bette Lucas, the most popular philanthropist in the wealthy town of Tyler, Texas, dies mysteriously and her son Steven is accused of murder.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Night Horrors
programme.desc: A woman asleep in her living room is brutally attacked with a hammer in the middle of the night. Even though one of her daughter witnesses the attack through a glass door she can't help her screaming mother because the perpetrator locked the doors.

programme.desc: Kapten Piggvar och hans kusin dyker ner i havet för att ta kort på en ovanlig sjösnigel, men dykarklockan fastnar nere i djupet. // Ett oväder har spolat bort bävern Gnagis damm. För att bygga en ny, gnager han av allt trä på Bonden Yumis gård.

programme.desc: När en apa rymmer från sin bur på ett tåg, ger sig Ryder och Paw Patrol ut på en vild jakt genom hela Äventyrsbukten! // Ryder och Paw Patrol räddar en uggleunge och återförenar den med sin mamma.

programme.desc: Kapten Piggvar krockar med en klippa och nu måste Paw Patrol laga hans båt och rädda honom, men en av valparna tar sig vatten över huvudet. // Paw Patrol kämpar för att rädda bondens Yumis grödor när en snöstorm dragit in lagom till höstfestivalen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vaplarna Dansar Fyrhusboogie / Valparna Räddar Ryder
programme.desc: Borgmästare Rospigg och Alex ror ut till havs för att titta på en val. Plötsligt drar en storm in och Paw Patrol måste rädda dem från vågorna. // Ryder försöker rädda en geten från en klippa men fastnar. Han ringer Paw Patrol men tappar sin Valp-pad!

programme.desc: Ryder och Paw Patrol räddar en bortsprungen katt som drivit ut till havs men väl på land rymmer katten upp på stadshusets tak. // Efter ett stenras sitter Katie och Smulan fast på ett tåg på en gammal bro! Valparna måste snabbt få bort stenblocken.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar cirkusen / Kuckelikul med valparna
programme.desc: Ryder får ett samtal från cirkusdirektören. Det visar sig nämligen att elefanten Ellie har rymt från cirkuståget! // Borgmästare Rospiggs höna har försvunnit. Nu måste Ryder och Paw Patrol hitta Hönrietta igen.

programme.desc: Rubble låtsas att han är en supervalp, men när han hamnar i knipa måste Ryder och de andra valparna rädda honom! // När Ryder tappar kontrollen över sin nya robot krävs det att hela Paw Patrol hjälps åt för att hitta den igen.
